verdict: BPL clearly beats the periodic baseline (9 of 12 entities) but only ties the Markov baseline (5 of 12). With 4-27 training events per entity there is not enough data for program structure to beat memorised empirical frequencies, and one months-long tail gap dominates the deployer mean. What would be needed to beat Markov honestly: more events per creator (50+), longer observation windows, and richer event features (gas, value, callee) so programs can condition on more than time/chain/type. No perfect predictions occurred; nothing was overfit to 100%.
